jobDescription: A company that sells accounting software to small businesses handles about 12,000 support tickets a month. The Support Operations Specialist configures the ticketing platform, builds the automations that route and prioritise tickets, produces the weekly service-level report and keeps help-centre macros in step with product releases. The specialist works with the support team leads and the release managers. Hiring decisions are taken by the interview panel after it has read the evidence summary. The support team has 52 agents in three regional groups, each with two team leads. The specialist reports to the head of support, and changes to routing or prioritisation are tested in the platform's sandbox and approved by the support director before they are switched on. January is the busiest month because of the self-assessment tax deadline.
requirements: Configures the ticketing platform: forms, fields, groups and agent roles.
Designs and rolls out routing and prioritisation automations in the ticketing platform.
Produces the weekly service-level report on first-response and resolution times.
Plans support staffing for seasonal peaks such as the end of the tax year.
Keeps help-centre macros and saved replies aligned with each product release.

evidence.text: Configured Zendesk for a 45-agent support team at Ledgerly: ticket forms, custom fields, agent groups and role permissions across three product lines.

Designed and rolled out 18 Zendesk triggers and automations that route tickets by product and plan tier and raise the priority of payroll-deadline issues, testing each one in the sandbox before switching it on.
Produced the weekly service-level report on first-response and full-resolution times by queue, sent to the head of support every Monday.
Updated macros and saved replies after each monthly release, working from the release manager's change notes.
Helped the workforce planner gather ticket-volume history before the January peak.

Work sample: the change record for the payroll-deadline routing automation, with the trigger conditions, the sandbox test cases and their results, the switch-on date and the support director's approval.
HR verification note: employment at Ledgerly from August 2021 to the present as Support Operations Analyst, checked against the employer's confirmation of employment.
Recruiter logistics note: the candidate can start in five weeks and is able to attend the in-person panel at the Bristol office.

propositions.text: The candidate designed and rolled out 18 Zendesk triggers and automations for routing and prioritisation, sandbox-testing each, and the change record carries the support director's approval.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the automations and testing; the work sample is the approved change record for one of them.

propositions.rationale: The resume describes the configuration directly.
